name: Margaret Lindqvist
bio: A retired high school principal from Harlow, Margaret has served on the board since 2016 and chairs the governance committee.

name: Samuel Okonkwo
bio: Samuel runs a family farm east of Ashby and chairs the asset-liability committee.

name: Teresa Vance
bio: A certified public accountant with a practice in Copper Flats.

name: Hector Ruiz
bio: A nurse at Valley Medical Center and a lifelong Millbrook Springs resident.

name: Grace Whitaker
bio: Grace teaches computer science at Kestrel Community College and leads the board's technology committee.

name: Wei Chen
bio: Wei owns two restaurants in Wren Lake and mentors new business owners.

name: Ruth Abernathy
bio: A retired postmaster and the longest-serving member of the board.

name: Jonah Feld
bio: An internal auditor who chairs the supervisory committee, which hires the outside auditors.
